proposals.reason: Native-parent-attested inline episode source cannot be repaired by the existing script/route profiles.
proposals.recommendation: Generate a Brain-owned reusable catalogue-inline-token source family, not a provider-specific patch. Build typed evidence -> source parsing -> bounded token resolution -> terminal media validation; require compilation, exact rematerialized bytes, official NuvioTV correct episode/audio and sibling non-regression. No mutation authority from independent CI.

blueprint.causalTrigger: Official Android TV observed an episode JavaScript resource missing or replaced by HTML and zero extracted streams; independent runner observed inline epsN arrays, opaque lien identifiers and epsJeton on a separate catalogue path. No domain, episode, media or client playback identity has been verified.
blueprint.method: Create a generic Brain-owned inline catalogue family executor and its regression tests; discover the catalogue slug and season/voice from real current source; reference hypothesis: epsN is a reader slot and the array index selects the episode, not the inverse. Verify this hypothesis on the exact current source; parse opaque identifiers without ever evaluating upstream scripts, resolve an allowlisted same-origin token API only in an isolated client test, and pass the result to existing trusted terminal-media validation. Never hard-code an Anime-Sama URL, slug, token or bypass legacy playback gates. Preserve other provider families, audio and subtitles.
requiredEvidence: exact current JS bytes plus native TV run/fixture/source SHA
independent read-only source shape and selected episode index
current source-owned token resolver response and output contract
negative memory for exhausted script/route/adaptive profiles
acceptanceProof: Brain-generated bounded family code and unit test compile
candidate mutation actually generated, applied and rematerialized
source-pinned episode season, title, voice and player differ correctly
official NuvioTV decoded correct video and audio with terminal segments
representative compatible sibling and native client non-regression
blueprint.reentryPolicy: Brain family synthesis -> isolated compile -> exact current-byte rematerialize -> official NuvioTV episode/media/audio -> sibling non-regression -> Core eligibility; no direct publication

proposals.reason: 1 provider(s) exhausted every bounded Core Repair experiment variant and were explicitly deferred for a new strategy.
proposals.recommendation: Synthesize one or more new bounded repair/evidence strategies from the common failure cohorts and independent Lab observations. Do not recycle the exhausted bounded g2..g5 family or increase retry counts. Each new strategy must have an explicit causal trigger, negative-memory signature, playback/identity acceptance proof and regression test before it may re-enter Core Repair.
